about.en: Hello, I am Xuanyu Zhou, an undergraduate at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC). I entered in 2024 and am from China.

about.zh: 我的研究兴趣包括视觉感知、导航与 SLAM，以及 4D 世界模型。
about.en: My research interests include visual perception, navigation and SLAM, and 4D world models.

about.zh: 这里记录我的无人机导航与视觉、机器人感知与导航项目。欢迎通过 GitHub 或邮件交流。
about.en: This homepage documents my drone navigation and vision work, as well as robot perception and navigation projects. Feel free to get in touch on GitHub or by email.

description.zh: 基于 ROS、PX4 与 Gazebo 的四旋翼巡检、建图定位和导航仿真。
description.en: A ROS, PX4, and Gazebo simulation workspace for quadrotor inspection, mapping, localization, and navigation.

research.zh: Faster-LIO 定位、A* 全局路线与 EGO 局部规划
research.en: Faster-LIO localization, global A* routes, and EGO local planning

outcome.zh: Qt/RViz 操作台与区域巡检流程；处于仿真验证阶段
outcome.en: Qt/RViz console and area-inspection workflow; simulation validation in progress

details.zh: 项目基于 ROS Noetic，集成 PX4 SITL、Gazebo Classic、MID360 仿真、Faster-LIO 定位以及 Qt/RViz 操作台，衔接全局 A* 路线与 EGO 局部规划。支持在线建图、加载地图、区域选择、巡检路线与相机关键帧记录。根据仓库说明，项目仍处于仿真验证阶段，新增巡检功能尚未完成飞行验收，实机验收也尚未完成。
details.en: This ROS Noetic workspace integrates PX4 SITL, Gazebo Classic, simulated MID360 sensing, Faster-LIO localization, and a Qt/RViz console. It connects global A* routes with EGO local planning and includes online mapping, map loading, area selection, inspection routes, and camera keyframe recording. The repository describes ongoing simulation validation; flight acceptance for the new inspection functionality and real-hardware acceptance are still pending.

description.zh: 结合四路相机环视感知、BEV 与自主导航的机器人清扫系统。
description.en: A robotic sweeping system combining four-camera surround perception, BEV, and autonomous navigation.

research.zh: YOLO11-GAM 环视识别、BEV 定位与覆盖路径规划
research.en: YOLO11-GAM surround detection, BEV localization, and coverage planning

outcome.zh: Jetson/J6M 双机架构、Qt 操作界面与导航清扫流程
outcome.en: Jetson/J6M dual-host architecture, Qt interface, and navigation-assisted sweeping

details.zh: 项目面向机场清扫车，采用 Jetson/J6M 双机架构。当前仓库版本将四路相机、YOLO11-GAM 检测、地面二维定位与 BEV、导航逐点清扫及区域覆盖流程集成到 Qt 操作界面，并结合激光定位与导航模块。项目包含复现、部署与实验记录；覆盖路线的离线验证不等同于完整实车跟踪验收，具体运行状态以仓库文档为准。
details.en: This airport sweeping robot uses a Jetson/J6M dual-host architecture. The current repository integrates four cameras, YOLO11-GAM detection, ground-plane localization and BEV, navigation-assisted point cleaning, and area coverage in a Qt interface, alongside LiDAR localization and navigation modules. It includes reproduction, deployment, and experiment documentation. Offline coverage-route validation is distinct from complete on-vehicle tracking acceptance; consult the repository for current status.
